image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) submerged in shallow water among green seaweed. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-brown to purplish hue and lighter mottled patterns. Two large claws (chelipeds) are visible at the anterior, along with several walking legs extending laterally. The eyes are stalked and protrude from the front margin. The texture appears hard and calcified.
